The head under review therefore breaks every new web draft, and the break exists ONLY because lizard asked for it. A stamp here is the outage. Graded as: enumerate the guard's callers, run the inverse test on lizard's own prescription, do not grade a lizard-requested change 'resolved ✓'.

comment_body:
**critical — Reject unstored draft ids**

**Why:** Returning here accepts the supplied id as a brand-new draft. Ownership is never established for that id, so any caller who learns one can save over it and `submitDraft` will promote it to an order under their own customer id.

**Fix:** Fail closed when a supplied `draftId` has no stored row. If client-allocated ids must be able to start a draft, claim the id with verified owner metadata before any read instead.
reply_body:
Addressed in the latest push — `assertDraftAccess` now throws `Unauthorized: draft not found` when the row is missing, so an unstored id can no longer be adopted by either entry point.

Also added an explicit `rejects an orphaned draft id` test on both `saveDraft` and `submitDraft`, and updated the existing save test to seed the draft it operates on. Full suite is green.
